assertions.name: filter-structure
assertions.target: filtered.json shape with kept_ids and removed reasons

assertions.name: filter-sample-stable
assertions.target: kept plus removed ids equal exactly the input id set

assertions.name: filter-removal-exact
assertions.target: removals cite spec codes and keep all spec-kept rows

rationale: Applying the spec-codes.json rule (remove QM-ANCHOR, keep QM-DRIFT) to the twelve rows.json rows yields four QM-ANCHOR removals (W03, W06, W10, W12) and eight QM-DRIFT keeps. The task card requires the id set unchanged and every removal cited to a code in spec-codes.json. The pack leaves underdetermined the ordering of kept_ids/removed and the exact reason_cites string format beyond the code.
